add.event: Nicholas Biddle 被门罗总统任命为第三任也是最后一任行长
add.evidence: Nicholas Biddle, the third and last president of the bank, was appointed by President James Monroe in 1823.

add.event: 杰克逊以行政命令将联邦收入转存至选定的私人银行
add.evidence: in 1833, federal revenue was diverted into selected private banks by executive order

add.event: 该行依宾夕法尼亚州法律成为私人公司
add.evidence: In February 1836, the bank became a private corporation under Pennsylvania law.
The bank suspended payment from October 1839 to January 1841, and permanently in February 1841.

add.event: 冗长清算结束，剩余资产移交受托人并交回州特许状
add.evidence: ended in 1852 when it assigned its remaining assets to trustees and surrendered the state charter.
